human_objective: 继续更多因子的策略研究，找出更优秀的因子组合；同账户净胜率与净收益联合优化
instrument_scope: Binance USDT perpetual futures only; long and short
universe_reason: Original six-coin liquid baseline registered before40coin experiments; no result-based asset selection
historical_scope: Retrospective project history; reserved split prevents computation leakage within this experiment, not project-level independent OOS

clock.entry: bar open+10minutes; one complete buffer bar
clock.metrics_visibility: raw timestamp+10minutes; exact raw clock only, no forward interpolation
clock.funding_visibility: actual raw event timestamp+5minutes; past events only in features

factor_definitions.impact_residual20: 20min realized log return minus response expected from intercept and beta fit on prior24five-minute bars ending before current4bar window, divided by prior log-return volatility*sqrt4
factor_definitions.path_efficiency60: absolute12bar log return /sum12bar absolute log returns
factor_definitions.flow_exhaustion20: negative flow20*return20 /prior volatility; conditional price-flow interaction
factor_definitions.funding_sum24h: sum actual visible rates in past24h; unknown without full source coverage and at least1event
factor_definitions.oi_contraction60: max(-log(OI_u/OI_u_minus60min),0), exact delayed positive endpoints only; zero/missing endpoints unknown
factor_definitions.interactions: direct products of named contemporaneously available factors
factor_definitions.btc_residual60: 12bar return minus prior288bar OLS intercept*12 and beta*BTC12bar return; fit window ends before current12bar window
factor_definitions.relative_return20: contract return20 minus equal-weight mean return20 of the other five fixed contracts
factor_definitions.market_return20: equal-weight leave-one-out mean return20 of the other five; requires all six finite
factor_definitions.market_dispersion20: population standard deviation of six current completed return20 values
factor_definitions.breadth20: share of six completed return20 values positive minus0.5; all six required
factor_definitions.compression60_vs24h: std12bar five-minute returns divided by std288bar returns ending before current12bar window; positive denominator required
factor_definitions.global_account_logratio: log delayed raw count_long_short_ratio, positive known value at raw t-5min, visible at feature t+5min
factor_definitions.global_account_change60: current global_account_logratio minus exact raw60min-earlier logratio; no interpolation

failed_hypotheses_preserved: H02 top-position/account tilt prediction increment failed
H03 positive OI expansion x flow prediction increment failed

Public direction and autonomous OHLCV baseline rejected; no same-rule parameter search

labels.ambiguous_bar: stop before target; gap beyond stop uses worse open; profitable gap capped at target
labels.funding: actual future events and hourly mark proxy in labels only; never in input features

model.type: per-direction and per-sleeve pooled logistic L2 net-win classification plus ridge net-return regression
model.standardization: fit rows only; primary group comparison uses the same full-feature complete population
model.optimizer: scipy L-BFGS-B with analytic gradient; intercept unpenalized; no hyperparameter search

signal_selection.ranking: highest predicted net return, at most1small and1core proposal perbar; deterministic symbol tie break

native_stage: Only prediction-eligible frozen groups enter whole native selection-period accounts with3cost scenarios; labels alone do not qualify profitability

sources.use: discovery only; reported reversal edge below benchmark capture cost is not profitability evidence
global account ratio field interpretation only, no profitability evidence

hypothesis: Cross-asset relative rotation and volatility compression contain conditional information; delayed global account crowding interacts with absorption and funding/deleveraging. No account-position ratio divergence or positive OI-expansion formula reused.

prior_failed_round.change: New cross-asset and global-account state mechanisms; labels, costs, learner and thresholds unchanged
